deals.headline: Knighthead's Shelby buys 24.34% of Birmingham City Limited from Birmingham Sports Holdings
deals.summary: Birmingham Sports Holdings sold about 24.34% of Birmingham City Limited (BCL) to Shelby and assigned part of its shareholder loans, for about GBP5.3 million in aggregate; with the Oriental Rainbow shares Shelby held about 45.98% of BCL on completion in July 2023.

deals.headline: Shelby buys Oriental Rainbow's 21.64% of Birmingham City Limited and all of Birmingham City Stadium Ltd
deals.seller: Oriental Rainbow Investments Limited and Achiever Global Group Limited
deals.summary: Oriental Rainbow and Achiever Global Group agreed to sell Shelby all their BCL shares (about 21.64%), all shares in Birmingham City Stadium Ltd and the loans owed by BCL and the stadium company. The report gives no price for this part.

deals.headline: Shelby operating loan facility to Birmingham City, raised to GBP150m
deals.summary: Shelby provided an operating loan facility of GBP50.0m to Birmingham City Limited and the club under an agreement of 13 July 2023 (fixed interest 11.90%, seven years per the club's accounts), increased to GBP100.0m on 3 October 2024 and GBP150.0m on 23 July 2025; GBP101.1m was drawn before the November 2025 completion.

deals.headline: Tom Brady becomes a minority owner of Birmingham City
deals.summary: Tom Brady joined Knighthead Capital Management's partnership as a minority owner and became chairman of a new advisory board; no stake or price was disclosed.

deals.summary: ZO Future Group sold about 51.72% of Birmingham City Limited plus a GBP19.2m shareholder loan to Shelby for about GBP5.0m in cash; an independent valuer put the market value of 100% of the BCL group's equity at about -GBP83.7m at 30 June 2025. Shelby then held 96.64% per the club's statement.

notes: Revenue and the facts from the 2024/25 accounts come from the Companies House PDF, which is a scanned image: the evidence strings were transcribed from the page and a text search of the PDF will not find them. The 2024/25 season was played in League One (promoted with 111 points); the club returned to the Championship for 2025/26. The club's statement (via Football Business Journal) gives Shelby 96.64% of Birmingham City Limited after November 2025, while the ZO Future Group circular's structure chart shows 97.7%. The valuation is the independent valuer's market value of 100% of the Birmingham City Limited group's equity (negative, because of shareholder debt), not a franchise valuation; no Forbes/Sportico figure exists. Knighthead stakes in Shelby (59.47% / 23.51% / Wagner 7.23%) are stakes in the holding company, so stake_pct is left null on those rows. Stadium ownership: Shelby bought all of Birmingham City Stadium Ltd in 2023 (PSC since 13 July 2023; principal activity 'holding an investment property'), but no page read states that this company owns St Andrew's, so stadium_owner is null. Not found: chief executive (Garry Cook left January 2025; successor not confirmed on a citable page), kit supplier, social follower counts, honours. bcfc.com is a client-rendered app, so its news pages could not be cited.

ownership_summary: Knighthead Capital Management owns the club through Shelby Companies Limited, which bought 45.98% of parent Birmingham City Limited in July 2023 and the remaining 51.72% from Hong Kong-listed ZO Future Group (formerly Birmingham Sports Holdings) on 7 November 2025, taking it to 96.64%; Birmingham City Limited owns 100% of Birmingham City Football Club Limited. Shelby is itself owned about 59.47% by Knighthead Annuity & Life Assurance Company and 23.51% by Knighthead Master Fund, L.P. (more than 40 investors in all, the largest individual being Tom Wagner at about 7.23%); Tom Brady joined as a minority investor in August 2023.
